facts.value: A postgraduate degree is one of the biggest advantages you can have as you start or build your career. You learn new skills, improve your job prospects, and forge the first steps to the career you want.
EU fee status applies to Domestic or EU students, or students who have been resident as a taxpayer in EU/ EEA/Swiss State for 3 out of the last 5 years.
Non-EU fee status applies to all other students.
Tax relief is available on postgraduate tuition fees, up to €7,000 per person per course.

Approved postgraduate courses in private and publicly funded colleges in the State; Postgraduate courses in a university or publicly funded college in another EU member state or the UK; Postgraduate courses in a university or publicly funded third-level college in non-EU countries.
